subject: general
question: In which Indian city is one of the country’s ancient lakes, the 'Lendiya Talab' located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhopal.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 'Lendiya Talab' located at **Bhopal**.
 
• Bhopal is the capital city of Madhya Pradesh.
 
• Famous as the City of Lakes with the various natural and artificial lakes.&
